description: Dark AV event page: near-black surfaces, cyan and magenta neon glows, outlined glowing buttons, uppercase letterspaced type.

referenceProfile.thesis: Night-club signal: near-black surfaces let two neon accents carry everything — cyan for information and action, magenta for dates and the season pass.
signatureMoves: Glow shadows replace elevation; buttons are transparent outlines that fill on hover.
Radial neon washes at hero edges suggest stage lighting without images.
transferPreserve: Keep surfaces near-black and use only the two neon accents with letterspaced uppercase type.
transferAvoid: Do not add light surfaces, corporate grays, or a third accent color.
